summary: x = (E^F_bᴴJ_TE^F_b)⁻¹E^F_bᴴJ_T(E^F_b x), and E^F_bᴴJ_TE^F_b permutes coordinates.

steps.lean:
have := ((by simp [HasMatSize, floorBasis, mul_apply, -ite_mul, sum_boole_mul, -star_sum,
    Γ.data_mem_ofSize.2.1 _] : Γ.HasMatSize 1 (F.floorBasis b)ᴴ).mul Γ.gram_mem_ofSize.1).mulVec h
steps.claim: E^F_bᴴ·J_T·(E^F_b x) ∈ vecsOfSize(Γ, j+4): E^F_bᴴ has size 1 (its entries are 0, 1 and conjugates of entries of F's basis matrix, of size 1 by the gauge), J_T has size 1, and E^F_b x ∈ vecsOfSize(Γ, j).
E^F_bᴴJ_TE^F_b = planeSumGram(hyperbolic Gram) (gram_floorBasis) has exactly one entry 1 in each row and column, so E^F_bᴴJ_TE^F_b x is x with permuted coordinates; hence x ∈ vecsOfSize(Γ, j+4).
